form.title: Credits for Qualifying Children and Other Dependents
form.notes: refundable: mixed. Line 14 is the NONREFUNDABLE child tax credit and credit for other dependents and goes to Form 1040 line 19, inside the tax computation. Line 27 is the REFUNDABLE additional child tax credit and goes to Form 1040 line 28, inside the payments block. 2025 parameters read off the form's own face: $2,200 per qualifying child under 17 (line 5, raised from $2,000 by P.L. 119-21); $500 per other dependent (line 7); phase-out thresholds $400,000 married filing jointly and $200,000 all other filing statuses (line 9), reduced by 5% of the excess rounded up to the next $1,000 (lines 10 and 11); refundable portion capped at $1,700 per qualifying child (line 16b); earned income floor $2,500 with a 15% rate (lines 19 and 20). New for 2025, per the Instructions for Schedule 8812: 'Beginning in tax year 2025, you must have a valid SSN to claim the CTC or ACTC.' Printed revision: Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) 2025, Created 7/30/25.
